openscap_verdict: 100.0% Level 2 Compliant (SELinux Enforcing, FIPS enabled, audited RPM database)

controls.title: Kernel Pointer Hiding (kptr_restrict)
controls.rationale: Prevents unprivileged users and attackers from leaking kernel memory addresses to defeat KASLR.

controls.title: Kernel dmesg Restriction (dmesg_restrict)
controls.rationale: Prevents unprivileged local users from inspecting kernel ring buffer logs for diagnostic leakage.

controls.title: Unprivileged eBPF Disabled
controls.rationale: Mitigates speculative execution side-channels (Spectre-eBPF) by restricting eBPF bytecode loading to CAP_BPF / root.

controls.title: Process Core Dump Restrictions (suid_dumpable)
controls.rationale: Prevents sensitive credentials and in-memory cryptographic keys from being written to world-readable core dumps.

controls.title: Reverse Path Filtering (rp_filter)
controls.rationale: Enforces strict reverse path filtering to defeat IP address spoofing attacks.

controls.title: Drop Source Routed Packets (accept_source_route)
controls.rationale: Prevents attackers from dictating packet routing pathways through enterprise subnets.

controls.title: Permissions on /etc/shadow
controls.rationale: Ensures password hash tables are inaccessible to non-root accounts.

controls.title: Permissions on /etc/passwd
controls.rationale: Ensures user account definitions cannot be modified by unprivileged users.
